# Mentor Code of Conduct
Mentors help players learn the game. Players see you as a person of trust, so how you behave reflects on Wolfgate.
## Answering
Be kind and patient. Give accurate answers, link the guidebook where it helps, and say so when you aren't sure. Ask another Mentor in Mentor chat rather than guess.
## What Mentors don't do
Mentors don't rule on the rules, moderate players or settle disputes. You should always send those to Staff. Never use anything you learn through a ticket in character. Don't ask who a player is out of character.
## Sending to Staff
Send a question to Staff when it's about rules, other players, bugs, or anything you can't fix. Use Send to Staff on the ticket.
